column3: Close to the Hebrew; עִוְּדֻנִי (“have surrounded me”) is rendered “have bound me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “goodness of discernment” is rendered “good judgment,” and הֶאֱמָנְתִּי (“I believe”) “I believe.”
Close to the Hebrew; טָפְלוּ (“smeared”) is rendered “have forged.”
Close to the Hebrew; “their heart is gross like fat” is rendered “Their heart is as fat as grease.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “coins.”
Close to the Hebrew; the wish “may they see me and rejoice” is rendered as future, “will be glad when they see me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “merciful kindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; עִוְּתוּנִי (“wronged me”) is rendered “they treated me wrongfully.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “from searching.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּנֹאד (“a skin bottle”) is rendered “a wineskin.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; נִצָּב (“stands firm”) is rendered “is settled.”
